name: Washer watch
summary: The building's laundry room, live: washers and dryers in a row with portholes, a running load tumbling in its owner's color with minutes left, a finished one waiting with its owner's face. Tap a free machine to start yours, nudge whoever's load is done, and after a grace period move it out to the basket.
useWhen: is the washer free? calvin's load has been sitting there since 11
laundry room status for the building, who's using what
someone left wet clothes in the dryer again
coordinate laundry day so nobody waits
can i move your stuff out of washer 2
dontUseWhen: splitting the laundry card money (use settle-up)

place.description: Where the machines are, e.g. '412 Pine basement'

machines.description: Up to 4 machines in order: name ('Washer 1'), kind washer or dryer, who: whose load is in it or '' if free, left: minutes left now (0 means done), waited: minutes a done load has sat

grace.description: Minutes a done load can sit before anyone may move it out, e.g. 10
